label: anthropic
_note: Seven endpoints across four provider names (Anthropic, Google Vertex, Amazon Bedrock, Azure), all serving the same dated snapshot; verified 2026-08-12 via GET /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints. Same weights everywhere, so the pin buys reproducibility and a single serving stack rather than a different model. Quantization is reported as 'unknown' on every endpoint, so it cannot be ruled out. Pinned to the first-party 'anthropic' tag at $3.00/$15.00 per MTok.

label: openai
_note: Six endpoints across OpenAI, Azure and Amazon Bedrock, same dated snapshot. The OpenAI name alone covers three service tiers: 'openai' at $2.50/$15.00, 'openai/flex' at $1.25/$7.50 and 'openai/priority' at $5.00/$30.00. Pinned to the standard tier; flex would roughly halve cost but trades latency and capacity, which is not worth it on a sub-$2 run.

label: google
